order_wins: **Kalpataru Projects International** - announces **new orders and notifications of award totalling about Rs 2,025 crore** across power transmission and distribution, buildings and factories, and oil and gas, in Indian and international markets; it puts year-to-date FY27 wins at Rs 13,219 crore _(~8.4% of mcap)_.

**LCC Projects** - **emerges lowest bidder for the Rs 653.34 crore including GST Chhoti Kalisindh medium irrigation project in Jhalawar, Rajasthan**, a sprinkler and solar scheme on single-responsibility turnkey EPC terms over 36 months; the filing records an L-1 declaration, not an award _(~15.4% of mcap)_.

**Genesys International** - wins a **Rs 283 crore World Bank-funded contract from Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation for a GIS 3D digital-twin platform covering about 625 sq km**, geocoding some 25 lakh properties and mapping underground utilities, over two and a half years plus five years of maintenance _(~15.0% of mcap)_.

**Aastha Spintex** - secures a **non-cancellable order from JSK Textile of Halvad for about 750 tonnes of greige fabric worth roughly Rs 25 crore excluding GST**, executable over two years ex-mill and described as its entry into the fabric segment _(~6.3% of mcap)_.

**Kay Cee Energy & Infra** - receives a **Rs 21.84 crore Letter of Award including GST from Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Prasaran Nigam** to maintain 220 kV and 132 kV substations and lines across the Bhilwara, Chittorgarh and Udaipur circles of its Ajmer zone _(~22.2% of mcap)_.

**E Factor Experiences** - receives a **Rs 18.58 crore order from the Punjab Heritage & Tourism Promotion Board to develop an ecotourism experience at the Kanjli wetlands in Kapurthala**, including five years of operation and maintenance, with development in 12 months _(~9.4% of mcap)_.

**Mayasheel Ventures** - receives a **Rs 17.94 crore subcontract including GST from A&T Infracon to manufacture, supply and erect 190 running metres of two-cell precast RCC box culverts for a project in the Jammu sector**, over 12 months _(~23.6% of mcap)_.

**Agni Green Power** - accepts a **Rs 9.14 crore Letter of Acceptance from Mizoram's Power & Electricity Department to install a 1.5 MWp grid-connected solar plant at Zoram Medical College, Falkawn**, to be completed by July 2027 _(~30.5% of mcap)_.

**Canarys Automations** - wholly-owned Canarys Corp **wins a USD 780,000 order from Calibo Inc of Southfield, Michigan to provide AWS and Azure cloud services and support**, on a 12-month billing engagement from the date the statement of work is signed.

**H.G. Infra Engineering** - receives the **completion certificate for Package 1 of the six-lane Urban Extension Road-II in Delhi**, a Rs 1,393.11 crore NHAI EPC project declared fit for commercial operation from 28 February 2025; the certificate, not the award, is today's event.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Inox Green Energy Services** - **opens a qualified institutions placement and fixes the floor price at Rs 174.36 a share**, adopting the preliminary placement document and reserving the right to a discount of up to 5%, under an authority its EGM granted on 13 August.

**Wheels India** - **opens a qualified institutions placement and fixes the floor price at Rs 2,197.10 a share**, adopting the preliminary placement document under shareholder resolutions passed on 12 August and 17 September.
**Bonlon Industries** - receives **in-principle approval from both BSE and NSE for its proposed rights issue of fully paid-up equity shares**; the size, price and record date are not yet disclosed.

**Anondita Medicare** - **withdraws the nullification letter it had issued on 8 September, restoring its rights issue to 9,58,166 shares aggregating up to Rs 91.03 crore** from the 9,58,000 shares of the original letter of offer, and confirms allotment on that basis.
equity_allotments: **Indiabulls** - allots **51,55,00,000 convertible warrants at Rs 19.40, about Rs 1,000 crore in full on our arithmetic, and has received Rs 250.02 crore as the 25% upfront payment** - to promoter-group Phanes and Hermes and to EBISU Global Opportunities Fund and a Nyaasa India sub-fund; fresh warrants, not a conversion.

**Imagicaaworld Entertainment** - allots **2,34,82,500 equity shares at Rs 73.50 on conversion of warrants**, on receipt of the balance Rs 129.45 crore being 75% of an aggregate Rs 172.60 crore; promoter Malpani Parks converted 1,70,06,800 and none of the ten allottees left any warrant outstanding.

**Ramkrishna Forgings** - allots **34,00,000 equity shares at Rs 588 on conversion of warrants held by Chaitanya Jalan**, on receipt of the balance Rs 149.94 crore at Rs 441 a warrant; a past conversion completing a January 2026 preferential issue.

**PC Jeweller** - allots the **remaining 3,63,62,222 equity shares to promoter and managing director Balram Garg on conversion of warrants**, against a balance Rs 49.09 crore, completing all 9,72,22,222 warrants and lifting promoter holding to 39.10% from 38.88%.

**Encompass Design India** - allots **7,60,000 equity shares at Rs 250, Rs 19.00 crore, being the first tranche of a 38,10,000-share preferential issue** and covering the two non-promoter allottees whose consideration had been received.
m_and_a: **Dr. Lal PathLabs** - board approves acquiring a **70% stake in genomics diagnostics company SN Genelab for up to Rs 168 crore in cash plus a sales-linked earn-out capped at Rs 31.5 crore**; the Gujarat target turned over Rs 57.96 crore in FY26 and closing is due by 30 November _(~0.5% of mcap)_.

**Godrej Industries** - **sells 0.50% of associate Godrej Consumer Products in an open-market trade for Rs 450.12 crore**, retaining 23.23%; GCPL contributes 35.69% of its consolidated net worth and nothing to consolidated turnover _(~1.2% of mcap)_.

**Maithan Alloys** - buys **2,79,000 shares, or 0.24%, of listed ESDS Software Solution on the exchange for Rs 50.19 crore**, disclosed on crossing the Regulation 30 threshold and described as a treasury investment with no intention of acquiring control.

**Cochin Shipyard** - **executes the share purchase and shareholders' agreements to buy 23% of Dutch ship-design house Conoship International Holding for EUR 2.30 million**, with DIPAM clearance in hand, to enter European coastal and short-sea design work within two months.

**FSN E-Commerce Ventures** - **completes its acquisition of 51% of Aminu Wellness on a fully diluted basis**, the shares having been credited to its demat account, making Aminu a subsidiary; the board had approved the purchase on 4 August.

**Samvardhana Motherson International** - wholly-owned SMISL **completes the sale of its 26% holding in EPC joint venture AES (India) Engineering to partner T-NET Japan and its nominees**, on satisfaction of the conditions precedent.

**Quality Foils (India)** - board approves **selling its flexible hose and hose-pipe manufacturing and assembly line at Hisar to Ratnamani Metals & Tubes for Rs 5.40 crore**, a unit that contributed 3.15% of revenue and no net worth, to complete by 31 March 2027 _(~32.6% of mcap)_.

**Hirect** - **sells the residual part of its non-operational Dehradun plant by sale deed for Rs 4.50 crore** to two individual buyers unconnected with the promoter group; the plant has been idle since 2023.

**Shanti Overseas (India)** - board approves **selling its entire 4,56,000-share holding in material subsidiary Shaan Agro Oils & Extractions for Rs 4,560 in aggregate**, to an individual buyer, subject to a shareholders' special resolution; Shaan contributed 51.13% of income and carries negative net worth.

**Indo Borax & Chemicals** - **draws about Rs 225 crore of funding from a lending institution to finance its previously disclosed purchase of Kronox Lab Sciences shares**; the borrowing, not the acquisition, is today's disclosure.

**Waaree Energies** - board approves the **scheme amalgamating group company Indosolar, which turned over Rs 68.36 crore against Waaree's Rs 6,221.67 crore in the June quarter, into Waaree Energies** to put cell and module manufacturing in one entity.

**Ventive Hospitality** - the **NCLT Mumbai passes a procedural order directing shareholder and creditor meetings** on the scheme amalgamating Eon-Hinjewadi Infrastructure, Restocraft Hospitality and Wellcraft Infraprojects into it.

**EFC (I)** - issues the **NCLT-directed notices to shareholders and unsecured creditors for the demerger of wholly-owned EFC Limited's asset-light managed-office business into itself**; no shares are issued, no consideration is payable and the shareholding pattern does not change.

**Privi Speciality Chemicals** - dispatches the **NCLT-convened notice for a shareholders' meeting on 27 October to approve amalgamating Privi Fine Sciences and Privi Biotechnologies into itself**, with remote e-voting from 22 October.

**EMA Partners India** - **files the scheme merging wholly-owned EMA Partners Executive Search, Emagine People Technologies and EMA Decision Dynamics into itself** under the Section 233 fast-track route for wholly-owned subsidiaries.
capex_core: **NGL Fine-Chem** - **commences commercial production of Phase II of its Tarapur greenfield facility**, fully commissioning a site that has taken Rs 222 crore of investment funded by Rs 84 crore of bank term loans and Rs 138 crore of accruals; it states capacity cannot be given as one figure across its API mix _(~12.7% of mcap)_.

**Interarch Building Solutions** - **commences commercial production at Andhra Pradesh Unit 2 Phase-1 in Attivaram, taking installed capacity from 221,000 tonnes to 245,000 tonnes a year**, a heavy structural steel plant it inaugurated the same day.

**Balaji Amines** - **commissions its rebuilt acetonitrile plant at Unit-III, Chincholi MIDC, Solapur, lifting installed capacity to 1,440 tonnes a month** under its expansion and modernisation programme.

**Maruti Suzuki India** - **commissions a 300 kW green hydrogen electrolyser plant at Manesar as a pilot**, blending the hydrogen with natural gas as process fuel and using solar power that would otherwise be idle on holidays, with scale-up planned in Haryana and Gujarat.

**Filatex India** - **subscribes Rs 20.00 crore for 2,00,00,000 shares at Rs 10 in wholly-owned Ecosis**, taking its total investment there to about Rs 85 crore, to fund a polyester textiles recycling project, repay an intra-group loan and meet working capital.
business_updates: **Results season** — 3 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**GACM Technologies** - signs a **24-month memorandum of understanding appointing AIML Cloud Global Technologies exclusive distributor of its FIRM TALK ERP product**, with gross revenue split 50:50 and a minimum guaranteed sale of Rs 15 crore over the term, half of any shortfall payable by the distributor.

**Varun Beverages** - Zimbabwe subsidiary signs an **exclusive agreement to distribute Mondelez South Africa's chocolate, biscuit, candy and gum products in Zimbabwe** from 1 October, using the existing snacks network with no capex envisaged.

**Waaree Energies** - wholly-owned Waaree Clean Energy Solutions **enters the specialty gases business and is building an ultra-high-purity gases and chemicals plant at GIDC Saykha, Dahej**, to supply Indian semiconductor and solar cell makers that currently import most of it.

**FSN E-Commerce Ventures** - Nykaa and **BOLD, L'Oreal's corporate venture fund, agree to invest jointly in Indian beauty and personal-care brands, taking minority stakes only**, with founders keeping ownership control; no fund size or first investment is disclosed.

**L&T Technology Services** - announces a **partnership with industrial-AI firm Cognite through its Sustainability segment**, establishing a Cognite centre of excellence and certifying an initial 50-plus engineers to co-develop solutions for asset-intensive industries.

**Lemon Tree Hotels** - signs a **licence agreement for a 90-room Lemon Tree Hotel at Patancheru, Telangana**, to be managed by wholly-owned Carnation Hotels; it is the group's eighth property in the state, four of them operational.

**Arkade Developers** - marks two years since listing with **pre-sales up at an 18% compound rate to Rs 901 crore in FY26 and total income at Rs 828 crore**, having delivered 708 homes, and says its upcoming pipeline's projected gross development value is now about Rs 18,000 crore - a projection, not a booked number.
credit_rating_changes: **Spectrum Electrical Industries** - **CRISIL upgrades it to A-/Stable from BBB+/Stable on the long term and to A2+ from A2 on the short term**, across Rs 250 crore of bank facilities.
**Megatherm Induction** - **CRISIL upgrades it to BBB+/Stable from BBB/Stable and to A2 from A3+**, on an unchanged Rs 105 crore of rated bank facilities.
**JNK India** - **CRISIL revises its outlook to Stable from Negative while reaffirming A- and A2+**, on Rs 604 crore of bank facilities enhanced from Rs 457 crore.
**Aether Industries** - appoints CRISIL, which **assigns AA-/Stable and A1+ on Rs 636 crore of bank facilities**, against the ICRA A+ (Stable) and A1 the company reports as its previous ratings.

**Gravita India** - **ICRA assigns AA(Stable) and A1+ ratings to material subsidiary Rashtriya Metal Industries** across Rs 450 crore of long-term working-capital and unallocated limits and Rs 150 crore of short-term non-fund-based lines.

**Allcargo Global** - **CRISIL revises its ratings to A-/Stable on Rs 471 crore of long-term facilities and A2+ on Rs 37 crore of short-term facilities**; the intimation does not state the previous levels.
**Go Digit General Insurance** - **CRISIL reaffirms its AA- corporate credit rating but places it on Rating Watch with Developing Implications**.
**J.G. Chemicals** - **CARE Edge assigns A+/Stable and A1+ ratings across Rs 19.75 crore of bank facilities**, the company's first ratings from that agency.
distress_risk: **Kalpataru Projects International** - the **Additional Commissioner (Appeal) upholds a GST order for FY20 to FY22** carrying a Rs 1.45 crore penalty alongside Rs 1.45 crore of tax and Rs 0.15 crore of interest over input-tax-credit claims; the company says it will appeal further.

**Whirlpool of India** - clarifying a 20% one-day share move, it confirms **Whirlpool Mauritius told the board on 22 September it still intends to sell its shares to a third party as a control transaction, and is exploring that with more than one counterparty**; the company is not a party to those talks.
